purpose: Synthetic-only validation of the moving-block interval mechanics proposed by alpha-research-design-review-v1 section 11 before any v5 historical outcome access.

nullConstruction.outcome: Forward sums of synthetic daily shared plus idiosyncratic shocks over exactly H sessions, sampled every five sessions.
nullConstruction.predictors: Generated from a separately spawned RNG stream and independent of every target innovation.
nullConstruction.pairedForecastContrast: Two exchangeable independent synthetic forecast streams with the same scale; expected paired MSE difference is exactly zero by symmetry.
nullConstruction.selection: Top 20 percent of names by an independent synthetic selection score; expected selected mean and selected-minus-universe mean are zero.
nullConstruction.rankStatistic: Within-date rank correlation between an independent synthetic score and target; population value is zero.

acceptance.depthRule: A candidate is evaluable only when floor(calendarWeeks / blockWeeks) >= minimumEffectiveBlocks. A depth-ineligible sensitivity is reported DATA_INSUFFICIENT and is not a failure.
acceptance.failureRule: If a primary block violates any frozen tolerance in any evaluable DGP/depth cell, calibration is FAIL. Do not promote a sensitivity because it looks better; revise the method in a new documented protocol before historical outcomes.
acceptance.sensitivityRule: All registered sensitivity blocks are reported. They never replace a failed primary inside this protocol.

prohibitions: No historical return, label, score, prediction, result report, signal-history outcome artifact, or Alpha experiment may be read.
No simulation parameter may be estimated from real returns.
No seed, DGP, block grid, tolerance, calendar depth, statistic, or replication budget may be changed after viewing calibration results under this contract.
No historical outcome may select a block length.
No v5 preregistration or seal is created by this calibration protocol.
